summary: Clinuvel Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K attaching an ASX announcement providing an update on the clinical and regulatory path for SCENESSE (afamelanotide) in vitiligo. The update discusses timelines for CUV105 topline results in December 2026 and planned start of CUV107 Phase III in November 2026. It also mentions EMA review of the CUV107 protocol. No financial terms, transactions, or special-situation events are disclosed. This is a routine business update on drug development progress.
